SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element AS a_element,
  c.atomic_fraction AS a_atomic_fraction,
  c2.element AS b_element,
  c2.atomic_fraction AS b_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c2 ON c2.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  AND c2.atomic_fraction = 0.25
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ti'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pt'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ga'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'W'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Nb'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Sc'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    c.element,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Pd'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    OR (ps.is_stable = FALSE AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
  )
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ca.element AS a_site,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.value >= 180.0
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.site_label,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    cp.property_name,
    cp.tensor_component,

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable

  AND string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-') && ARRAY[
    'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
    'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
    'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg'
  ]::text[]

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
  AND cp_c11.value + 2 * cp_c12.value > 0
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.5 * CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull)
        END
        + 0.3 * GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.1)
        + 0.2 * (cp.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_combination_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, l12_combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q1: negative formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / unstable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4: positive formation energy / unstable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY stability_quadrant ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element AS a_site,
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d'
  END AS transition_metal_group,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND (
    c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn')
    OR c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
  )
ORDER BY transition_metal_group ASC, c.element ASC, ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull) END) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
    (
        (CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull) END)
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0)
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition ca
    WHERE ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND ca.atomic_fraction = 0.75
)
AND EXISTS (

    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'

SELECT DISTINCT

  ps.energy_above_hull,

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
    ((1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
     * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
     * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0)) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0

    0.40 * CASE WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    + 0.25 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    + 0.20 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    + 0.15 * (cp.value / (cp.value + 200.0))
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT
    ranked.formula,
    ranked.energy_above_hull,
    ranked.is_stable,
    ranked.lattice_a,
    ranked.lattice_diff,
    ranked."C11",
    ranked."C12",
    ranked."C44",
    ranked.stability_score,
    ranked.lattice_matching_score,
    ranked.elastic_score,
    ranked.stability_score * ranked.lattice_matching_score * ranked.elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_c11.value AS "C11",
        cp_c12.value AS "C12",
        cp_c44.value AS "C44",
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
        END AS stability_score,
        1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
             AND cp_c44.value > 0
             AND cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value > 0
            THEN (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
    WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
) ranked
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE 'Pd' = ANY(string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Cu'

   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Cu'
   OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Cu-%'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'is_l12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_stability.value <= 0.1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system = 'Co'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula LIKE '%Co3%'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Al(-|$)'
       OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ti(-|$)')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_al_l12_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_al_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    cp_stability.value AS stability,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Fe%'
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_a
    WHERE c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
      AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_b
    WHERE c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
      AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stable.value AS is_stable,
  cp_mismatch.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS c11,
  cp_c12.value AS c12,
  cp_c44.value AS c44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_mismatch ON cp_mismatch.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_l12.property_name = 'prototype'
  AND cp_l12.tensor_component = 'L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
  AND cp_mismatch.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
  AND ABS(cp_mismatch.value) <= 0.02
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY ABS(cp_mismatch.value) ASC, (cp_c11.value - cp_c12.value) DESC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND (m.formula LIKE '%Co%' OR ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.10)
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stab.value AS stability,
  ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (-cp_stab.value)
    + 0.3 * (-ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57))
    + 0.3 * cp_bm.value
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_lat ON cp_lat.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_lat.property_name = 'lattice_a'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE m.chemical_system LIKE '%Ni%'
  AND m.chemical_system LIKE '%Al%'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    m.formula ~ '(^|[^A-Za-z])Ni([0-9A-Z]|$)'
    OR m.formula ~ '(^|[^A-Za-z])Co([0-9A-Z]|$)'
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'is_stable' AND cp.value = 1) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'is_stable' AND cp.value = 0) AS unstable_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'is_stable') AS total_stability_records,
       AVG(cp.value) FILTER (WHERE cp.property_name = 'is_stable') AS stable_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'is_stable'
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY stable_fraction DESC, total_stability_records DESC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.entry_id)
        m.entry_id,
        m.formula,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_st ON cp_st.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_st.property_name = 'is_stable'
        AND cp_st.value = 1
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY m.entry_id, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, bulk_modulus DESC) AS ranking,
    formula,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_diff,
    bulk_modulus
FROM candidates
ORDER BY ranking
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS c11,
  cp_c12.value AS c12,
  cp_c44.value AS c44,
  (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0 AS bulk_modulus_estimate,
  cp_stab.value AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lat ON cp_lat.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_lat.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
ORDER BY
  cp_stab.value ASC,
  ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) ASC,
  ((cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0) DESC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    cp_la.value AS lattice_a,
    ABS(cp_la.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_la ON cp_la.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Co%'
  AND cp_la.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ABS(cp_la.value - 3.57) ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       NULL::numeric AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low energy above hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q2: high formation energy / low energy above hull'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 THEN 'Q3: low formation energy / high energy above hull'
    ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / high energy above hull'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_lattice.value AS lattice_a,
       ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC) AS ranking,
  formula,
  is_stable,
  energy_above_hull,
  lattice_a,
  lattice_diff,
  c11 AS "C11",
  c12 AS "C12",
  c44 AS "C44",
  stability_score,
  lattice_match_score,
  elastic_score,
  composite_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    formula,
    is_stable,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_diff,
    c11,
    c12,
    c44,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_match_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
  FROM (
    SELECT
      m.formula,
      ps.is_stable,
      ps.energy_above_hull,
      s.lattice_a,
      ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
      cp11.value AS c11,
      cp12.value AS c12,
      cp44.value AS c44,
      CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
      END AS stability_score,
      1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
      GREATEST(
        0.0,
        LEAST(
          cp11.value - cp12.value,
          cp44.value,
          cp11.value + 2.0 * cp12.value
        )
      ) AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry AS m
    JOIN structure AS s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
    JOIN calculation AS calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property AS cp11 ON calc.calculation_id = cp11.calculation_id
    JOIN calculated_property AS cp12 ON calc.calculation_id = cp12.calculation_id
    JOIN calculated_property AS cp44 ON calc.calculation_id = cp44.calculation_id
    WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
      AND cp11.tensor_component = 'C11'
      AND cp12.tensor_component = 'C12'
      AND cp44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  ) AS base_scores
) AS ranked_scores
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    ranked.formula,
    ranked.is_stable,
    ranked.energy_above_hull,
    ranked.lattice_a,
    ranked.lattice_diff,
    ranked.bulk_modulus,
    ranked.weighted_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.is_stable,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
        (
            0.4 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull DESC) +
            0.3 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) DESC) +
            0.3 * PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.value ASC)
        ) AS weighted_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND cp.value IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND NOT (m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp_bm.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
    END AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp.value AS elastic_score,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
        END
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * cp.value
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom,
       COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_per_atom,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
